title: VPC deployment gate auditor — comprehensive install vetting for quotas, IAM, DNS, and GPU capacity
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an extensible, opinionated 'gate auditor' that runs before Private/VPC installs to validate quotas, IAM roles/policies, DNS/resolver topology, and GPU SKU capacity. Outputs machine-readable results, human-friendly remediation steps, and actionable remediation commands (Terraform snippets / request links). Integrate with the existing terraform modules and the installer CLI so CI and onboarding flows can fail fast with clear next steps.
acceptance_criteria: CLI command redwood-preflight audit <tenant-config> exits 0 when environment meets all checks
Checks implemented: cloud quotas (CPUs, vCPUs, GPUs, IPs), service enablement, IAM roles & least-privilege heuristic, private DNS zones and resolver reachability, GPU SKU availability per region
Tool emits a machine-readable JSON summary with explicit exit codes and a short human-readable remediation section
Automated remediation suggestions include Terraform data sources/snippets and pre-filled quota request links for AWS/GCP/Azure
Run in CI (installer pipeline) and gate PR merges to private-deploy repo if failures are high-impact
Documentation and runbook added to Confluence and linked from the installer error output
tasks: Spike: enumerate provider-specific quota API endpoints and required permissions
Design: canonical output schema and exit code table
Implementation: terraform-friendly checks module (data-only) and installer CLI wrapper
E2E: run against staging tenant with synthetic quota limits to validate messages
Integrate: installer pipeline and add gating rule for private deploys
Docs: Confluence runbook + user-facing troubleshooting guide
Security review: verify least-privilege checks and service account patterns
progress_updates: 2025-09-11: Spike complete — documented quota endpoints for AWS (Service Quotas), GCP (Compute & IAM quotas), Azure (Subscription quotas). Found inconsistent reporting for pre-provisioned GPUs across providers.
2025-09-14: Prototype CLI that queries AWS Service Quotas and checks for requested GPU SKU availability. Prototype prints remediation suggestions for quota increase requests.
2025-09-16: Design review — accepted canonical output schema (status, issues[], remediation[], suggested terraform_snippets[]). Decided to include an optional --format json flag for CI integrations.

2025-09-18: Implemented IAM checks: validates required roles exist, flags overly broad policies, and emits recommended least-privilege policy snippets. Feedback from Security: include justification field for any auto-suggested changes.

2025-09-20: DNS checks added: verifies presence of private hosted zone or forwarded resolver, tests DNS resolution from within a customer VPC via short-lived probe instance. Found edge-case for cross-account shared resolvers — added additional check and note.
2025-09-24: GPU capacity heuristic implemented: queries capacity API, falls back to SKU spot/ondemand historical availability, suggests alternate SKUs and regions. Preparing PR for infra repo.
notes: Trade-offs: Running live probes is more accurate but requires temporary credentials and creates transient resources — default behavior will be dry-run with explicit --live-probe flag.
Decision: Report non-blocking warnings for soft limits (e.g., ip addresses) but block on hard limits for GPUs and required services not enabled.
Mitigation flows: where possible include terraform data source snippets so customers can copy/paste into their infra to fix quickly.
UX: Error output must be actionable within 80 chars and include a single actionable example (terraform snippet or console link).
qa_plan: Create synthetic tenant with artificially low GPU quota to validate blocking behavior
Test cross-account resolver scenarios and verify error messages are clear
Run installer CI with --format json and assert schema compatibility
Nightly smoke with live-probe against staging provider accounts to detect API drift
postmortem_considerations: If a customer experiences an install outage due to missed quota, add the tenant ID and offending check to the incident timeline
Track false positives and add provider-specific heuristics to reduce noise
Add telemetry to Console to show preflight pass/fail trends across regions
